'''Vols''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gorgen]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He once approached [[Tera (Human)|Tera]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and threatened her before fleeing after a fight.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
